candidates.name: Brown tumor
support_spans: a large tumor on the distal part of the right fourth finger
Histopathology of finger tumor
Numerous giant cells with multiple osteoclastlike nuclei and giant multinucleated cells dispersed in contact with fibers associated with small vessels
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with a large tumor on the finger and the histopathology results are consistent with a brown tumor.

candidates.name: Hyperparathyroidism-related osteodystrophy
support_spans: primary hyperparathyroidism 6 years prior to presentation
Hypercalcemia at 3.6 mmol/L
Hypophosphatemia at 0.65 mmol/L
candidates.why: The patient's history of primary hyperparathyroidism and laboratory results are consistent with hyperparathyroidism-related osteodystrophy.

candidates.name: Hyperparathyroidism
support_spans: primary hyperparathyroidism 6 years prior to presentation
Elevated serum parathyroid hormone at 380 pmol/L
candidates.why: The patient's history of primary hyperparathyroidism and elevated parathyroid hormone levels are consistent with this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Osteitis fibrosa cystica
support_spans: Radiography showed complete lysis of the underlying phalanx and periosteal bone resorption in the phalangeal tuft band
Skull radiography showed pattern of trabecular resorption with 'salt-and-pepper' appearance
candidates.why: The patient's radiography results are consistent with osteitis fibrosa cystica.
